name: ao
summary: Installs the Automation Orchestrator operator and its owned local resources.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reconciles the owned operator resources, catalog, and AutomationOrchestrator custom resource.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before applying workload resources when the cluster, catalog, storage, or pull-secret prerequisites are unavailable.

readiness: The owned operator subscription and AutomationOrchestrator workload are ready.
AAP controller wiring succeeds without exposing credentials.

security.secret_storage: Generated and supplied credentials are handled through Kubernetes secrets or the encrypted credential Vault.
security.network_trust: Catalog and AAP connections retain configured cluster and ingress trust.
security.external_actions: No workflow run or external service action is launched automatically.
